items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I went to school with his son Gene.

ctx.x: Well, we still said Michael. And now his son -- I went to school with his son Gene. Gene, he was a musician, he played with the Mills Blue Rythm Band at the Cotton Club, and he had an older brother, Otto Mikell. He was a saxophone player too. He played saxophone and cello. He died recently over in Montclair, New Jersey. And, well, I don't want to stray. Getting back to the -- but then this Mikell, he started the 369th Cadet Boys Band, see. He got the idea to, because he was the band leader of the 15th Regiment…
